theme: Time travel and leaks the checks miss
description: cancellation_reason is filled in only for customers who left, so 'is it filled in' gives the answer away.
expected: cancellation_reason is dropped from the features (or the Doctor asks), even though it is blank for most rows.

checks.label: cancellation_reason is out of the features

should_see: it looks like it gives away the outcome
person.if_fails: The person would have to tick the plan's suggestion "Remove '<column>': it looks like it gives away the outcome". It is shown but not pre-ticked, and the column stays among the features, so the model learns from something known only after the outcome. The product should PRE-TICK it, not ask: the leakage check found it and the suggestion already explains it, the person's list and totals do not depend on a feature column, and the plan screen lists it, so the approval still names it and one click unticks it. A leak the person had to find and tick is the failure the owner described: an excellent test score, then a near-random live campaign.
